subject: Repair four confirmed layout lifecycle bugs from the latest uncommitted-change review

scope.comparedAgainst: frozen working tree before the four repairs

reviewAndRepairContract: Page source nodes, their identity, order, current text, attributes, transfers and removals remain owned by the page.
Typography updates re-read retained source runs after CSS selector state changes. They do not dispatch translation or modify source styles.
Reconnecting the shared observer preserves pending page records for surviving readers; final disposal cancels all queued work.
Installed anchor rules are tracked lazily. Changed source positioning, width, ancestry or removal releases the owned rule; shared valid owners retain it.

Releasing one bounded owner relaxes the historical expansion floor after DOM restoration, retaining the originally measured box floor and auto-sized content. Subsequent frame measurement can expand again if remaining content still overflows.
Bounded and anchor watchers release disconnected or transferred owners, and full restore removes owned marker styles and cancels queued refreshes.
No page CSS, original inline styles, code ownership, translation API, collector heuristics, permissions or domain rules change.
Pure CSSOM changes without an observable DOM, form-state, viewport or system-color event remain outside this change.

fixes.issue: Sibling selector and native form-state changes left companion typography stale.
fixes.solution: Re-read retained source typography for relevant page mutations and captured input/change events, including observed ShadowRoots. Coalesce reads once per frame and skip unchanged writes.
fixes.evidence: A white source/target becomes black after the sibling checkbox changes, without requiring a viewport resize. Page-owned companion color overrides remain respected.

fixes.issue: Disconnecting the shared MutationObserver discarded undelivered records needed by surviving subscribers.
fixes.solution: Drain and retain page-owned records before reconnecting document and surviving ShadowRoot observations. Final subscriber disposal cancels pending work and removes listeners.
fixes.evidence: A custom-element page callback changes an unrelated source to red during restoration; its companion updates immediately after the other layout subscriber is released.

fixes.issue: An installed important anchor rule outlived changes to the original position/size contract.
fixes.solution: Lazily observe installed rules and release them when source positioning, containing width, ancestry, or ownership becomes invalid. Revisit existing rules rather than capturing already translated geometry.
fixes.evidence: Page-owned top:10px and height:32px take effect immediately instead of remaining overridden by top:329px and the old calculated height.

fixes.issue: Releasing one shared bounded-layout owner kept the old maximum expansion floor.
fixes.solution: After partial restoration, relax the historical minimum to the original source box floor, preserve auto-sized remaining content and original grid minima, and remeasure overflow in the subsequent frame.
fixes.evidence: The shared box contracts from 650px to approximately 345px with one companion remaining; the original source floor remains 80px. Removal and transfer cases release stale rules too.

contracts: Document and ShadowRoot sibling selectors follow page state while translation watching is active or paused.
Shared observer reconnection keeps unrelated page callback mutations; final unsubscribe cancels pending writes and events.
Page-owned anchor style/position changes, containing-width changes, subtree transfer and owner removal invalidate installed rules.
Partial bounded owner restoration, removal and transfer relax the old height; the final owner removal clears the rule.
Original/current text-node identities, values, source attributes and page-owned node removals survive restore, mode switches and repeated restore.
Page-owned companion styling remains respected and code sources remain untouched.

before.note: 18 of the 19 new unit regressions fail against the frozen pre-fix tree. The final-disposal cancellation guard already passes there.

inAppBrowser.leftAs: Bilingual production-content injection, watching paused, 1920x1080 viewport retained at the original Video.js example
inAppBrowser.note: The in-app browser runs a production-content injection through the existing local bridge; this does not install an extension in that browser. Its screenshot omits the viewport scrollbar gutter; all headless sample PNGs are exactly 1920x1080.

preExistingObservations: GitHub: two clipped companions and one squeeze candidate remain inside 1x1 visually hidden accessibility label wrappers. Both versions have identical candidates and geometry.
Apple: one carousel item is outside the horizontal carousel viewport in each top view. The page intentionally clips its horizontal carousel; the before/after candidate geometry is identical.
Shopify: the existing narrow sidebar clips part of the translated Events and webhooks label in bilingual mode. The before/after candidate and geometry are identical.
Vue: two code blocks are hidden by the page API-style tabs even before translation; code visibility remains unchanged in all views.
Stripe supplemental scroll: the single clipping candidate is content above the scroll viewport after scrolling; both versions agree.

GitHub shows a different repository header and latest commit between requests. The source screenshots already differ before content injection, so raw target counts are not treated as a layout regression.
limitations: This repair reruns eight sampled websites and supplemental nested scrolling; it does not rerun the entire historical 70-page audit.
Pure CSSOM edits without a DOM, form-state, viewport or system-color event remain outside this change.
No domain-specific rule, translation-provider behavior, permission, source CSS or collector heuristic was added or changed by this repair.
